pages.text: Set a nearby Android as a spy with $(bold)/androidscompat spy on$(). Use spy cover <name> to set a cover identity, spy off to deactivate it, and $(bold)/androidscompat intel$() to request a nearby intelligence report. Capture, imprison and release commands manage nearby captives.

With Simple Voice Chat installed, $(bold)/androidscompat speak <text>$() makes the nearest Android speak through proximity voice. Configure tts.endpoint in serverconfig/androidscompat-server.toml with an HTTP(S) service that accepts UTF-8 text and returns PCM WAV audio. TTS is not bundled.
